name: Offline de Ecchi na Level Age
original_name: オフラインでエッチなレベル上げ
source: The protagonist runs a guild for an online game.  He attends a real-life meetup and is surprised to learn the identity of one of his online teammates, who turns out to be a very cute young girl.  Although rest of the guild treats her a little coldly, she is attracted to the kind protagonist.  The new couple begin to raise their erotic levels both online and offline.
